SELECT sc.id AS id, sc.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(sp.view_count), 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_revenue), 0) AS salesRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(sp.refund), 0) AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(sp.net_sales), 0) AS netSales, COALESCE(SUM(sp.investment), 0) AS investment FROM sub_company sc LEFT JOIN session_performance sp ON sp.company_id = sc.id AND sp.tenant_id = #{req.tenantId} AND sp.stats_date BETWEEN #{req.startDate} AND #{req.endDate} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sc.tenant_id = #{req.tenantId} AND sc.is_deleted = 0
AND sc.id IN
#{id}
AND sc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.name}, '%')
GROUP BY sc.id ORDER BY
viewCount salesRevenue refund netSales investment salesRevenue
ASC DESC

SELECT d.id AS id, d.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(sp.view_count), 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(SUM(sp.sales_revenue), 0) AS salesRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(sp.refund), 0) AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(sp.net_sales), 0) AS netSales, COALESCE(SUM(sp.investment), 0) AS investment FROM dept d LEFT JOIN session_performance sp ON sp.dept_id = d.id AND sp.tenant_id = #{req.tenantId} AND sp.stats_date BETWEEN #{req.startDate} AND #{req.endDate} AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.tenant_id = #{req.tenantId} AND d.is_deleted = 0
AND d.company_id = #{req.companyId}
AND d.id IN
#{id}
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.name}, '%')
GROUP BY d.id ORDER BY
viewCount salesRevenue refund netSales investment salesRevenue
ASC DESC
